The '''HT-150''' was a model of [[light freighter]] manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. It included at least one cargo bay and two [[engine]]s. One such freighter named the ''[[Iron Talon]]'' was used by<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[prince]] [[Cyrus Vuundir]] of [[Vuundalla]]<ref name="Aftershock">{{YJA|Aftershock}}</ref> under his [[pirate]] alias<ref name="The Young Jedi">{{YJA|The Young Jedi}}</ref> Taborr Val-Dorn.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
